description: This file defines the LatLng class and related functions for representing and manipulating geographical points with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude in the Leaflet mapping library.

classes.name: LatLng
classes.description: Represents a geographical point with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude, including methods for comparison, distance calculation, wrapping, and bounds creation.

methods.name: LatLng
methods.description: Constructor for creating a LatLng object with latitude, longitude, and optional altitude.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another LatLng object is at the same position within a margin of error.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LatLng object.

methods.name: distanceTo
methods.description: Calculates the distance in meters to another LatLng point.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Returns a new LatLng with longitude wrapped between -180 and +180 degrees.

methods.name: toBounds
methods.description: Creates a LatLngBounds object around the point with specified size in meters.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the LatLng object.

methods.name: toLatLng
methods.description: Factory function that creates a LatLng object from various input formats (LatLng, array, object, or individual coordinates).
